[[Prism Tower]] }} '''Pangoro Poses a Problem''' (Japanese: '''ゴロンダ、探る''' ''{{tt|Goronda|Pangoro}}, Search'') is the 562nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 14th chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Alexa]] finishes her report of the [[Vaniville Town]] incident. * Alexa learns from [[Viola]] what happened in [[Santalune City]]. * Alexa heads off to [[Prism Tower]] to have an interview with [[Professor Sycamore]]. * {{adv|X}} reveals he decided to keep [[Marisso]] and [[nickname]]d {{p|Charmander}} [[Salamè]]. * Upon arriving, Alexa finds that the [[Lumiose Press editor-in-chief]] has already done the interview in her place. * Sensing that something is wrong, X heads into Prism Tower and finds Alexa being attacked by the editor-in-chief. * X rescues Alexa, but the editor-in-chief captures {{p|Helioptile|Heli}} and holds it hostage. * {{adv|Y}} takes Alexa to safety and promises that X will rescue Heli. * Alexa realizes that some force must be controlling the media to make sure the truth about Vaniville Town does not become public knowledge. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Pangoro}} * {{p|Spewpa}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|X}} * {{adv|Y}} * {{adv|Trevor}} * {{adv|Tierno}} * {{adv|Shauna}} * [[Professor Sycamore]] * [[Viola]] (video) * [[Malva]] (video) * [[Lysandre]] (flashback and fantasy) * [[Alexa]] * [[Sina]] * [[Dexio]] * [[Lumiose Press editor-in-chief]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Kangaskhan}} ([[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]];
